title: Better Digital Display
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: your silos and farm on a glowing screen

hand.do: Go to one of your Better Digital Display screens
hand.why: Stand in front of it, close enough to read it. Walking there is not in the video.

caption.heading: Your storage, live
caption.text: How full, what's in it, rates and alerts.

hand.do: Open Monitor settings, then Colours > Amber terminal

caption.heading: Monitor settings
caption.text: Colours, brightness, size, your own title.

caption.heading: Prices
caption.text: The best price for each product, right on the wall.

hand.do: Monitor settings > Pick the storage > My fields (or Weather)

caption.heading: The whole farm
caption.text: Fields, weather, vehicles, contracts, money, a history chart.

hand.do: Press End and Home to flip through the screens

caption.heading: Flip through
caption.text: Home and End switch screens; Page Up and Down turn pages.
